title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear matrix mix captures a high‑energy show highlighted by an electrifying Shakedown Street and a soaring Dupree's Diamond Blues.
ai_review.review: The recording is a superb matrix blend that delivers board‑like crispness with the excitement of the audience, making every nuance audible. The performance bursts with energy from the opening Shakedown Street through a standout Dupree's Diamond Blues and tight second‑set jams, earning it rave praise from fans.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are overwhelmingly positive (5‑star except one 4‑star) and consistently highlight both an excellent recording and a top‑tier performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, board‑like clarity combined with audience ambience; no dropouts or major flaws mentioned, praised as one of the best‑sounding releases.

standout_songs: I Ain't Got No (I’m a) – IAON
Scarlet Begonias / Fire on the Mountain
Spanish Jam > Truckin' > The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: A blistering opening set that builds momentum, seamless transitions (notably into Dupree's), and a tight second set with strong jams; the show maintains high excitement throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his powerful strumming on Good Times and overall stellar guitar work throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboards are described as playful, leading the band and keeping everyone “fever‑ish” from the start.
